knowledge:
- key_parameters: file=The path to the input BAM file (e.g., position-deduplicated BAM files) ;; genome=Character representing the reference genome, either "hg38" or "hg19" (default is "hg38") ;; mates=Integer representing the minimum number of EML4-ALK mate pairs needed to call a variant (default is 2) ;; basepairs=Integer representing the number of basepairs identified from the EML4-ALK fusion (default is 20) ;; gene=Character string representing the gene, either "ALK" or "EML4"
- alternatives: The documentation mentions "commercially available NGS products such as the AVENIO (Roche) pipeline" which this package aims to complement by increasing sensitivity. No other R packages are explicitly mentioned as alternatives.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing paired-end sequencing BAM files (especially position-deduplicated BAMs from targeted hybridization NGS approaches like AVENIO ctDNA surveillance kit) to detect and characterize EML4-ALK gene fusion variants in blood plasma (ctDNA).
- pitfalls: If no EML4-ALK fusion is present, functions will return "No EML4-ALK was detected" or "No ALK-EML4 was detected" or empty GAlignments objects, which can cause downstream errors if not handled. The package is specifically designed for EML4-ALK and uses transcripts ENST00000389048.8 (ALK) and ENST00000318522.10 (EML4); it may not generalize to other fusions.

workflows.name: eml4_alk_fusion_analysis
workflows.intent: Detect, characterize, and identify EML4-ALK gene fusion variants and breakpoints from paired-end BAM files.
input: file.bam (Paired-end sequencing BAM file, preferably position-deduplicated)
workflows.stages: 1. Detect EML4-ALK mate pair reads using EML4_ALK_detection() ;; 2. Identify EML4 sequence leading to the breakpoint using EML4_sequence() ;; 3. Identify ALK sequence following the breakpoint using ALK_sequence() ;; 4. Identify genomic breakpoint positions using break_position() ;; 5. Calculate read depth at the breakpoint using break_position_depth() ;; 6. Perform a combined analysis using EML4_ALK_analysis() ;; 7. Identify introns containing the breakpoint using introns_ALK_EML4() ;; 8. Identify the specific EML4-ALK variant using find_variants()
workflows.code:
H3122_bam <- system.file("extdata", 
                            "H3122_EML4.bam",
                            package = "DNAfusion")
H3122_result <- EML4_ALK_detection(file = H3122_bam, 
                        genome = "hg38", 
                        mates = 2) 
EML4_sequence(H3122_result, genome = "hg38", basepairs = 20)
ALK_sequence(H3122_result, genome = "hg38", basepairs = 20)
break_position(H3122_result, genome = "hg38", gene = "EML4")
break_position_depth(H3122_bam, H3122_result, genome = "hg38", gene = "EML4")
H3122_results <- EML4_ALK_analysis(file = H3122_bam, 
                                    genome = "hg38", 
                                    mates = 2, 
                                    basepairs = 20)
introns_ALK_EML4(file=H3122_bam,genome="hg38")
find_variants(file=H3122_bam,genome="hg38")
